purpose: MiMo-V2.6-Flash (MOPD checkpoint) on TabbyAPI 2636ef60 + exllamav3 1.6.1: the post-out-scales-fix 2.52 bpw EXL3 pack, one 262,144-token slot with Q8 K/V, DFlash drafting (4-bit EXL3 drafter, 7 draft tokens), images on. Launched through scripts/lib/tabby_launch.py, which serves only the readiness and inference routes. Switch alias mimo26flash (owner direction 2026-10-12); qwen38fn stays the default. 1M does not fit beside 94 GiB of weights.

status.basis: M3 candidate 3 (results/mimo-v26-flash-gates/qualify-2026-10-13-c1/RESULT.md) qualified this launch: the frozen scorer returned PASS on every preregistered clause (no NVRM/Xid/OOM, swap 0, low 9.56 GiB against the 8 GiB floor, peak 105.71 GiB, direct 262K fill of 250,135 tokens, text probes identical to preflight r2, tool-call 20/20, agent gate 4/4, 30-minute soak at the repository's 5 GiB floor, MMMU-val-100 68/100 against the default's 64). Fidelity against the release weights is lossy and reported, not waived: dNLL 0.0503, KLD 0.0836, top-1 -0.94 pp (results/mimo-v26-flash-gates/smoke-2026-10-13). The owner directed the integration on 2026-10-12 as a switchable alias; qwen38fn stays the default. Candidates 1 and 2 were frozen and reviewed but never started; the preflights (results/mimo-v26-flash-gates/preflight-2026-10-13*) are diagnostic history.

safety.note: 8 GiB whole-host floor, the production precedent (qwen38fn). minimum_start_gib = ceil(peak + 8) from candidate 3's run (peak 105.71 GiB). CUDA allocations on GB10 are not charged to the memory cgroup, so MemoryHigh/MemoryMax bound only host-side pages (page cache of the 94 GiB pack read, the Python heap); the external memwatch floor is the binding control.

memory_model.basis: Measured by M3 candidate 3 (results/mimo-v26-flash-gates/qualify-2026-10-13-c1): peak use 105.71 GiB = 94.98 GiB of pack and drafter + 3.59 GiB of Q8 K/V at 262,144 (14,688 B/token: exllamav3 caches only the 9 global-attention layers; the 39 SWA-128 layers and the drafter's 5 SWA-1024 layers keep fixed per-slot rings) + overhead_gib, rounded up to 0.1 GiB. The overhead is the CUDA context, Q8 staging scratch, torch allocator slack, the vision tower and the TabbyAPI process, including the host-RAM caches capped at 512 MB of sliding-window checkpoints and 256 MB of image embeddings (scope anon peak 4.28 GB).

qualification_options.note: vision_max_tokens: in chat mode MiMo answers MMMU with worked steps; at the bench's 256-token default 4 of 20 answers ran out of budget mid-calculation (finish_reason length; results/mimo-v26-flash-gates/preflight-2026-10-13/kit/vision). Thinking mode has no effort level here and would spend more.
